quote.text: Settle on the type of person you want to be and stick to it, whether alone or in company.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Embrace the role of being a steadfast example for your children; when you decide the type of person you want to be, let that decision guide every interaction, nurturing trust and consistency in the young hearts of your family.
    • Whether you are alone with your thoughts or surrounded by family, remain true to your chosen values. Your unwavering character teaches children that integrity does not waver with circumstance, reinforcing the lessons you pass on.
  • Leadership:
    • True leadership requires consistency of character. When you settle on the type of leader you wish to become, you create a model of reliability and inspiration, encouraging your team to also embrace steadfast values.
    • In the solitude of reflection or the scrutiny of the public eye, maintaining your chosen identity builds resilience. By staying true to your ethics and vision, you earn the respect and loyalty of those you serve.
  • Product Management:
    • Just as you settle on who you are, commit to a clear vision for your product. This consistency in values and goals will guide every decision, ensuring that the product evolves with integrity and purpose.
    • Whether in strategy sessions or private moments of analysis, let your established principles steer your work. A steadfast approach not only instills confidence in your team but also creates a reliable brand identity for all who interact with your product.
